risk: Clone perception / weak originality in actual play
mitigation: Physical port/relay/switch/Load identity; Phase 002 originality gate; avoid competitor layout/marketing

risk: Command scarcity becomes busywork or obvious toggling
mitigation: Remove repetitive controls; strengthen routing/priorities; keep two or more defensible allocations

risk: One-board readability collapses as systems accumulate
mitigation: Information hierarchy; overlays; non-color cues; remove low-value state; controller parity

risk: Controlled randomness still feels like restart fishing
evidence_gate: Phase 040 seeded fixtures and fair-loss interviews
mitigation: Forecasts; rerolls/banishes/weighting; sidegrades; no mandatory counter hidden in offers

risk: Scope expands beyond solo-production ceiling
evidence_gate: Every phase closure and monthly scope review
mitigation: Phase 005 ceilings; change request; cut ladder before scope growth

risk: Art/animation pipeline throughput misses roadmap
mitigation: Modular library; batch export; silhouette-first; simplify material/animation complexity before adding staff/content

risk: Pinned Blender/tool versions or exports are not reproducible
mitigation: Version manifest; scripted export; clean-machine reproduction; ADR for upgrades

risk: Engine/tool upgrade destabilizes deterministic behavior or imports
evidence_gate: Any proposed toolchain change; Phase 020/094 regression
mitigation: Pin versions; migration branch; rollback; full deterministic/import gate

risk: Doctrines become cosmetic percentage variants
mitigation: Require structural rule change and different routing/build decisions; cut redundant modifiers

risk: One dominant build collapses replayability
evidence_gate: Phase 091 seed sweeps; Phase 107 external feedback
mitigation: Doctrine/boss matrix; interaction nerfs; preserve multiple viable archetypes

risk: Run exceeds 35–50 minute target through housekeeping
mitigation: Automate upkeep; collapse known resolution; remove redundant actions before cutting strategic decisions

risk: Losses are opaque or feel unfair
evidence_gate: Phase 040 fair-loss fixtures; Phase 099 demo runs
mitigation: Forecast rules; authoritative previews; causal event log; post-run root-cause explanation

risk: Market research is treated as a sales forecast
mitigation: Label hypotheses; refresh primary evidence; separate demand shape from revenue forecast

risk: Public demo is released before representative quality
mitigation: Hold or skip event window; never weaken demo gate to meet calendar

risk: UI/animation becomes authoritative simulation state
evidence_gate: Phase 014 kernel and all integration tests
mitigation: Typed deterministic model; simulation events drive presentation; headless fixtures

risk: Save/replay determinism is designed too late or diverges
mitigation: Run-owned seed/RNG; command log; schema versions; golden replay/save fixtures

risk: Controller/accessibility becomes late rework
mitigation: Input abstraction early; no-hover information; non-color cues; controller-first representative fixtures

risk: Content quantity substitutes for strategic depth
mitigation: Every item needs unique job/counter; fix interactions before adding content; enforce ceilings

risk: CPU/GPU/memory/install budgets miss targets
mitigation: State-change recomputation; pooling/batching; asset downsample; simplify effects before target-hardware expansion

risk: Dependency/plugin/service creates removal or offline risk
evidence_gate: Dependency addition review; Phase 095 offline/export gate
mitigation: Necessity record; pinned version/license; removal path; offline fallback

risk: Charterwake public name conflicts with earlier rights
mitigation: Keep title provisional; official/fuzzy/common-law search; rename-safe IDs and source files

risk: Schedule reserve is exhausted before release hardening
evidence_gate: Weekly dashboard; monthly scope review; Phase 070/100/112
mitigation: Protect 75-day reserve; cut ladder; re-estimate; C5 release reserve cannot fund optional content

risk: External project cash exceeds chosen scenario
evidence_gate: Monthly scope review; before contract commitment
mitigation: Choose scenario explicitly; quotes before spend; cut/defer specialist work; no hidden living-cost assumption

risk: Localization/source-text churn causes rework
mitigation: Stable IDs/keys; source lock; reserve optional lore cuts; linguistic QA after lock

risk: Playtest cohort is biased or too small to support decisions
mitigation: Minimum fresh-player cohorts; record recruitment/context; separate qualitative signals from population claims

risk: Launch/support burden exceeds solo capacity
mitigation: Hotfix pipeline; rollback; support triage template; no live-service commitment
